        self.weapon.update(delta_time)
        
        # Update power-ups
        self.update_power_ups(delta_time)
        self.apply_power_up_effects()
        
        # Update perception based on game state
        self.perception["enemies"] = [
            robot for robot in game_state.robots 
            if robot.team != self.team and robot.is_alive and self.can_see(robot.position)
        ]
        
        self.perception["allies"] = [
            robot for robot in game_state.robots 
            if robot.team == self.team and robot.is_alive and robot.id != self.id and self.can_see(robot.position)
        ]
        
        # Update position based on current velocity
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * delta_time
        
        # Keep robot in bounds (simple boundary system)
        self.position.x = max(0, min(game_state.arena_width, self.position.x))
        self.position.y = max(0, min(game_state.arena_height, self.position.y))
        
        self.last_updated = time.time()

@dataclass
class Objective:
    """Represents a team-based objective"""
    id: str
    type: ObjectiveType
    team: Team
    position: Vector2D
    status: str = "inactive"  # inactive, active, completed
    capture_points: int = 0
    max_capture_points: int = 10
    required_allies: int = 2
    is_defensive: bool = False
    timer: float = 0.0
    respawn_time: float = 30.0
    
    def activate(self):
        """Activate objective"""
        self.status = "active"
        self.capture_points = 0
        self.timer = 0.0
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float, robots: List[Robot]):
        """Update objective state"""
        if self.status != "active":
            return
            
        # Count allies near objective
        nearby_allies = sum(1 for robot in robots 
                           if robot.team == self.team 
                           and robot.is_alive 
                           and robot.position.distance_to(self.position) < 5.0)
        
        # Update capture progress
        if nearby_allies >= self.required_allies:
            self.capture_points += 1 * delta_time
        else:
            # Slow decay if not enough allies
            self.capture_points = max(0, self.capture_points - 0.1 * delta_time)
        
        # Check completion
        if self.capture_points >= self.max_capture_points:
            self.status = "completed"
            self.timer = time.time() + self.respawn_time
            return
        
        # If no allies nearby for too long, deactivate
        if nearby_allies < self.required_allies and self.capture_points < 2:
            self.timer += delta_time
            if self.timer > 10.0:  # 10 seconds without allies
                self.status = "inactive"
                self.capture_points = 0

@dataclass
class PowerUp:
    """Power-up item in the arena"""
    id: int
    type: PowerUpType
    position: Vector2D
    spawn_time: float
    respawn_time: float = 45.0
    collected: bool = False
    duration: float = 10.0  # duration of effect when collected
    
    def is_available(self, current_time: float) -> bool:
        """Check if power-up is available for collection"""
        if self.collected:
            return current_time >= self.spawn_time + self.respawn_time
        return True

@dataclass
class Hazard:
    """Environmental hazard in the arena"""
    id: int
    type: HazardType
    position: Vector2D
    radius: float
    damage_per_second: float
    active: bool = True
    
    def apply_damage(self, robot: Robot, delta_time: float) -> float:
        """Apply damage to robot if within hazard"""
        distance = robot.position.distance_to(self.position)
        if distance < self.radius and self.active:
            damage = self.damage_per_second * delta_time
            return robot.take_damage(damage)
        return 0.0

@dataclass
class GameState:
    """Current state of the entire game"""
    arena_width: float = 100.0
    arena_height: float = 100.0
    robots: List[Robot] = field(default_factory=list)
    objectives: List[Objective] = field(default_factory=list)
    power_ups: List[PowerUp] = field(default_factory=list)
    hazards: List[Hazard] = field(default_factory=list)
    team_scores: Dict[Team, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {Team.RED: 0, Team.BLUE: 0})
    game_time: float = 0.0
    match_duration: float = 300.0  # 5 minutes
    difficulty_level: float = 0.5  # 0.0 to 1.0
    round_number: int = 1
    last_update_time: float = 0.0
    audio_events: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    visual_effects: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    battle_history: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def get_team_robots(self, team: Team) -> List[Robot]:
        """Get all robots of a specific team"""
        return [robot for robot in self.robots if robot.team == team]
    
    def get_alive_robots(self) -> List[Robot]:
        """Get all alive robots"""
        return [robot for robot in self.robots if robot.is_alive]
    
    def get_active_objectives(self) -> List[Objective]:
        """Get all active objectives"""
        return [obj for obj in self.objectives if obj.status == "active"]
    
    def get_available_power_ups(self) -> List[PowerUp]:
        """Get all available (not collected) power-ups"""
        current_time = time.time()
        return [pu for pu in self.power_ups if not pu.collected and pu.is_available(current_time)]
    
    def get_hazards_in_range(self, position: Vector2D, radius: float) -> List[Hazard]:
        """Get hazards within a radius of position"""
        return [h for h in self.hazards 
                if h.active and h.position.distance_to(position) < radius]

class RobotBehavior(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for robot behavior patterns"""
    
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, game_state: GameState):
        self.robot = robot
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.current_target: Optional[Vector2D] = None
    
    @abstractmethod
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        """Return target position and action command"""
        pass
    
    def get_best_objective(self) -> Optional[Objective]:
        """Find the most valuable objective for this robot"""
        if not self.game_state.objectives:
            return None
        
        # Prioritize objectives based on team and status
        team_objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
                          if obj.team == self.robot.team and obj.status == "active"]
        
        if team_objectives:
            # Prefer objectives that are close to completion
            return min(team_objectives, key=lambda x: x.max_capture_points - x.capture_points)
        
        # If no active team objectives, look for enemy objectives
        enemy_objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
                           if obj.team != self.robot.team and obj.status == "active"]
        
        if enemy_objectives:
            # Prefer objective closest to robot
            return min(enemy_objectives, key=lambda x: self.robot.position.distance_to(x.position))
        
        # If no active objectives, find any objective to capture
        inactive_objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.status == "inactive"]
        if inactive_objectives:
            return min(inactive_objectives, key=lambda x: self.robot.position.distance_to(x.position))
        
        return None
    
    def get_closest_enemy(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find closest enemy robot"""
        enemies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.robots 
            if robot.team != self.robot.team and robot.is_alive
        ]
        if not enemies:
            return None
        return min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
    
    def get_closest_ally(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find closest ally robot"""
        allies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.robots 
            if robot.team == self.robot.team and robot.is_alive and robot.id != self.robot.id
        ]
        if not allies:
            return None
        return min(allies, key=lambda a: self.robot.position.distance_to(a.position))
    
    def get_nearest_power_up(self) -> Optional[PowerUp]:
        """Find nearest available power-up"""
        power_ups = self.game_state.get_available_power_ups()
        if not power_ups:
            return None
        return min(power_ups, key=lambda pu: self.robot.position.distance_to(pu.position))

class AttackerBehavior(RobotBehavior):
    """Behavior for attacking robots"""
    
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        # Find the closest enemy
        closest_enemy = self.get_closest_enemy()
        if closest_enemy and self.robot.weapon.can_fire():
            # Aim and shoot at enemy
            aim_dir = self.robot.get_aim_direction(closest_enemy.position)
            self.current_target = closest_enemy.position
            return closest_enemy.position, "attack"
        
        # If no enemy in range, pursue objective
        objective = self.get_best_objective()
        if objective:
            self.current_target = objective.position
            return objective.position, "objective"
        
        # Wander if no target
        self.current_target = self._random_wander()
        return self.current_target, "wander"
    
    def _random_wander(self) -> Vector2D:
        """Generate a random point to wander toward"""
        angle = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
        distance = random.uniform(5.0, 15.0)
        x = self.robot.position.x + distance * math.cos(angle)
        y = self.robot.position.y + distance * math.sin(angle)
        # Clamp to arena boundaries
        x = max(0, min(self.game_state.arena_width, x))
        y = max(0, min(self.game_state.arena_height, y))
        return Vector2D(x, y)

class DefenderBehavior(RobotBehavior):
    """Behavior for defending robots"""
    
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        # If defending a base, stay near it
        defending_objectives = [
            obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
            if obj.team == self.robot.team and obj.status == "active" and obj.is_defensive
        ]
        
        if defending_objectives:
            # Prioritize defending the objective with lowest capture progress
            target_obj = min(defending_objectives, key=lambda x: x.capture_points)
            self.current_target = target_obj.position
            return target_obj.position, "defend"
        
        # If no specific defense objective, guard the team's base
        base_positions = [
            obj.position for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
            if obj.team == self.robot.team and obj.status != "completed"
        ]
        
        if base_positions:
            # Average of all base positions
            avg_x = sum(p.x for p in base_positions) / len(base_positions)
            avg_y = sum(p.y for p in base_positions) / len(base_positions)
            self.current_target = Vector2D(avg_x, avg_y)
            return self.current_target, "guard"
        
        # If no objectives, engage closest enemy
        closest_enemy = self.get_closest_enemy()
        if closest_enemy:
            self.current_target = closest_enemy.position
            return closest_enemy.position, "engage"
        
        # Default: patrol around a central point
        self.current_target = self._patrol_point()
        return self.current_target, "patrol"
    
    def _patrol_point(self) -> Vector2D:
        """Define a patrol point for defenders"""
        # Patrol near the center of the team's side
        center_x = self.game_state.arena_width * 0.75 if self.robot.team == Team.RED else self.game_state.arena_width * 0.25
        center_y = self.game_state.arena_height * 0.5
        # Add slight random variation
        offset_x = random.uniform(-5.0, 5.0)
        offset_y = random.uniform(-5.0, 5.0)
        return Vector2D(center_x + offset_x, center_y + offset_y)

class SupportBehavior(RobotBehavior):
    """Behavior for support robots"""
    
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        # Look for allies that need help
        low_health_allies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.get_team_robots(self.robot.team)
            if robot.is_alive and robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.4
        ]
        
        if low_health_allies:
            # Go to the ally with lowest health
            target_ally = min(low_health_allies, key=lambda a: a.health)
            self.current_target = target_ally.position
            return target_ally.position, "heal"
        
        # If no allies in need, support objective
        objective = self.get_best_objective()
        if objective:
            # Help with objective capture
            self.current_target = objective.position
            return objective.position, "support_objective"
        
        # Look for power-ups
        nearest_power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if nearest_power_up:
            self.current_target = nearest_power_up.position
            return nearest_power_up.position, "collect_powerup"
        
        # Patrol and scan for threats
        self.current_target = self._patrol_point()
        return self.current_target, "scan"
    
    def _patrol_point(self) -> Vector2D:
        """Define a patrol point for support robots"""
        # Patrol between key locations
        objectives = [obj.position for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.team == self.robot.team]
        if not objectives:
            return Vector2D(self.game_state.arena_width * 0.5, self.game_state.arena_height * 0.5)
        
        # Cycle through objectives
        index = int(self.game_state.game_time) % len(objectives) if objectives else 0
        return objectives[index]

class ScoutBehavior(RobotBehavior):
    """Behavior for scout robots"""
    
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        # Scan for enemies and objectives
        enemies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.robots 
            if robot.team != self.robot.team and robot.is_alive
        ]
        
        # If enemies are detected, report and track
        if enemies:
            # Find the most threatening enemy (highest health, closest)
            target_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: e.health * 0.5 + self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
            self.current_target = target_enemy.position
            return target_enemy.position, "track"
        
        # Find the furthest objective to scout
        objectives = [
            obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
            if obj.status == "active" and obj.team != self.robot.team
        ]
        
        if objectives:
            # Go to the objective farthest from our team's base
            target_obj = max(objectives, key=lambda o: self.robot.position.distance_to(o.position))
            self.current_target = target_obj.position
            return target_obj.position, "scout_objective"
        
        # Explore new areas
        self.current_target = self._explore_area()
        return self.current_target, "explore"
    
    def _explore_area(self) -> Vector2D:
        """Explore uncharted areas of the map"""
        # Find the point on the map farthest from known positions
        # Simple version: move toward a corner
        corners = [
            Vector2D(0, 0),
            Vector2D(self.game_state.arena_width, 0),
            Vector2D(0, self.game_state.arena_height),
            Vector2D(self.game_state.arena_width, self.game_state.arena_height)
        ]
        
        # Find the corner farthest from current position
        farthest_corner = max(corners, key=lambda c: self.robot.position.distance_to(c))
        
        # Add some randomness to exploration
        offset_x = random.uniform(-10, 10)
        offset_y = random.uniform(-10, 10)
        return Vector2D(
            max(0, min(self.game_state.arena_width, farthest_corner.x + offset_x)),
            max(0, min(self.game_state.arena_height, farthest_corner.y + offset_y))
        )

class CarrierBehavior(RobotBehavior):
    """Behavior for payload carriers"""
    
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        # Find payload objectives
        payload_objectives = [
            obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
            if obj.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT and obj.team == self.robot.team and obj.status == "active"
        ]
        
        if payload_objectives:
            target_obj = payload_objectives[0]  # Assume only one payload objective
            # Move toward the objective's destination
            self.current_target = target_obj.position
            return target_obj.position, "escort"
        
        # If carrying a payload, protect it
        # Find other robots carrying payload
        carriers = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.get_team_robots(self.robot.team)
            if robot.role == RobotRole.CARRIER and robot.is_alive
        ]
        
        if carriers:
            # Stay near the carrier
            main_carrier = carriers[0]
            self.current_target = main_carrier.position
            return main_carrier.position, "protect_carrier"
        
        # Look for power-ups to boost payload delivery
        nearest_power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if nearest_power_up:
            self.current_target = nearest_power_up.position
            return nearest_power_up.position, "collect_powerup"
        
        # Default: move toward team base
        base_positions = [
            obj.position for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
            if obj.team == self.robot.team and obj.type == ObjectiveType.PAYLOAD_ESCORT
        ]
        
        if base_positions:
            target = base_positions[0]
            self.current_target = target
            return target, "return_base"
        
        # Wander if no clear target
        self.current_target = self._random_wander()
        return self.current_target, "wander"

class AdaptiveDifficulty:
    """Adaptive difficulty system that adjusts based on robot performance"""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.difficulty = 0.5  # Base difficulty (0.0 - 1.0)
        self.performance_history = deque(maxlen=10)  # Last 10 rounds' performance metrics
        self.adjustment_cooldown = 0
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update difficulty based on performance metrics"""
        if self.adjustment_cooldown > 0:
            self.adjustment_cooldown -= delta_time
            return
            
        # Calculate performance metrics
        performance = self._calculate_performance()
        self.performance_history.append(performance)
        
        # Adjust difficulty based on average performance
        if len(self.performance_history) >= 5:  # Need at least 5 data points
            avg_performance = sum(self.performance_history) / len(self.performance_history)
            
            # If team is winning too easily, increase difficulty
            if avg_performance > 0.7:
                self.difficulty = min(1.0, self.difficulty + 0.05)
                logger.info(f"Difficulty increased to {self.difficulty:.2f} - Team performing well")
            # If team is struggling, decrease difficulty
            elif avg_performance < 0.3:
                self.difficulty = max(0.0, self.difficulty - 0.05)
                logger.info(f"Difficulty decreased to {self.difficulty:.2f} - Team struggling")
            
            # Reset cooldown
            self.adjustment_cooldown = 15.0  # Wait 15 seconds before next adjustment
    
    def _calculate_performance(self) -> float:
        """Calculate team performance metric (0.0 to 1.0)"""
        red_robots = self.game_state.get_team_robots(Team.RED)
        blue_robots = self.game_state.get_team_robots(Team.BLUE)
        
        # Count alive robots
        red_alive = sum(1 for r in red_robots if r.is_alive)
        blue_alive = sum(1 for r in blue_robots if r.is_alive)def _calculate_performance(self) -> float:
        """Calculate team performance metric (0.0 to 1.0) based on objective completion, robot survival, and damage dealt."""
        red_robots = self.game_state.get_team_robots(Team.RED)
        blue_robots = self.game_state.get_team_robots(Team.BLUE)
        
        # Count alive robots
        red_alive = sum(1 for r in red_robots if r.is_alive)
        blue_alive = sum(1 for r in blue_robots if r.is_alive)
        
        # Count completed objectives for each team
        red_completed = sum(1 for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.team == Team.RED and obj.status == "completed")
        blue_completed = sum(1 for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.team == Team.BLUE and obj.status == "completed")
        
        # Total objectives and total robots (alive and dead)
        total_objectives = len(self.game_state.objectives)
        total_robots = len(self.game_state.robots)
        
        # Avoid division by zero
        if total_objectives == 0 and total_robots == 0:
            return 0.5
        
        # Weighted performance: 50% survival, 50% objective completion
        red_score = (red_alive / max(total_robots, 1)) * 0.5 + (red_completed / max(total_objectives, 1)) * 0.5
        blue_score = (blue_alive / max(total_robots, 1)) * 0.5 + (blue_completed / max(total_objectives, 1)) * 0.5
        
        # Return red team's performance relative to total
        if red_score + blue_score == 0:
            return 0.5
        return red_score / (red_score + blue_score)    def get_ai_level(self) -> float:
        """Get adaptive AI level"""
        return self.difficulty

class StrategyLearner:
    """Machine learning component for strategy adaptation"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.strategy_weights = {
            "attack": 0.3,
            "defend": 0.3,
            "support": 0.2,
            "scout": 0.2
        }
        self.success_history = deque(maxlen=20)  # Last 20 successful strategies
        self.last_update_time = 0.0
    
    def update(self, game_state: GameState, delta_time: float):
        """Update strategy weights based on battle outcomes"""
        if time.time() - self.last_update_time < 10.0:  # Update every 10 seconds
            return
            
        # Analyze recent battle outcomes
        if len(game_state.battle_history) > 0:
            recent_battles = game_state.battle_history[-10:]  # Last 10 battles
            success_rates = self._calculate_success_rates(recent_battles)
            
            # Adjust strategy weights based on success rates
            for role, success_rate in success_rates.items():
                if success_rate > 0.6:  # High success
                    self.strategy_weights[role] = min(1.0, self.strategy_weights[role] + 0.05)
                elif success_rate < 0.3:  # Low success
                    self.strategy_weights[role] = max(0.1, self.strategy_weights[role] - 0.05)
            
            # Normalize weights
            total_weight = sum(self.strategy_weights.values())
            if total_weight > 0:
                for role in self.strategy_weights:
                    self.strategy_weights[role] /= total_weight
        
        self.last_update_time = time.time()

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D position and velocity vector"""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        length = self.length()
        if length == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return Vector2D(self.x / length, self.y / length)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()

class RobotBehavior(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for robot behavior patterns"""
    
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, game_state: GameState):

        if not self.game_state.objectives:
            return None
        
        # Prioritize objectives based on team and status
        team_objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
                          if obj.team == self.robot.team and obj.status == "active"]

            # Prefer objectives that are close to completion

        # If no active team objectives, look for enemy objectives

                           if obj.team != self.robot.team and obj.status == "active"]
        
        if enemy_objectives:
            # Prefer objective closest to robot
            return min(enemy_objectives, key=lambda x: self.robot.position.distance_to(x.position))
        
        # If no active objectives, find any objective to capture
        inactive_objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.status == "inactive"]
        if inactive_objectives:
            return min(inactive_objectives, key=lambda x: self.robot.position.distance_to(x.position))
        
        return None
    
    def get_closest_enemy(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find closest enemy robot"""
        enemies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.robots 
            if robot.team != self.robot.team and robot.is_alive
        ]
        if not enemies:

        return min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
    
    def get_closest_ally(self) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find closest ally robot"""
        allies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.robots 
            if robot.team == self.robot.team and robot.is_alive and robot.id != self.robot.id

        ]
        
        if low_health_allies:
            # Go to the ally with lowest health
            target_ally = min(low_health_allies, key=lambda a: a.health)
            self.current_target = target_ally.position
            return target_ally.position, "heal"
        
        # If no allies in need, support objective
        objective = self.get_best_objective()
        if objective:
            # Help with objective capture
            self.current_target = objective.position
            return objective.position, "support_objective"
        
        # Look for power-ups
        nearest_power_up = self.get_nearest_power_up()
        if nearest_power_up:
            self.current_target = nearest_power_up.position
            return nearest_power_up.position, "collect_powerup"
        
        # Patrol and scan for threats
        self.current_target = self._patrol_point()
        return self.current_target, "scan"
    
    def _patrol_point(self) -> Vector2D:
        """Define a patrol point for support robots"""
        # Patrol between key locations
        objectives = [obj.position for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.team == self.robot.team]
        if not objectives:
            return Vector2D(self.game_state.arena_width * 0.5, self.game_state.arena_height * 0.5)
        
        # Cycle through objectives
        index = int(self.game_state.game_time) % len(objectives) if objectives else 0
        return objectives[index]

class ScoutBehavior(RobotBehavior):
    """Behavior for scout robots"""
    
    def decide_action(self, delta_time: float) -> Tuple[Optional[Vector2D], Optional[str]]:
        # Scan for enemies and objectives
        enemies = [
            robot for robot in self.game_state.robots 
            if robot.team != self.robot.team and robot.is_alive
        ]
        
        # If enemies are detected, report and track
        if enemies:
            # Find the most threatening enemy (highest health, closest)
            target_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: e.health * 0.5 + self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
            self.current_target = target_enemy.position
            return target_enemy.position, "track"
        
        # Find the furthest objective to scout
        objectives = [
            obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives 
            if obj.status == "active" and obj.team != self.robot.team
        ]
        
        if objectives:
            # Go to the objective farthest from our team's base
            target_obj = max(objectives, key=lambda o: self.robot.position.distance_to(o.position))
            self.current_target = target_obj.position
            return target_obj.position, "scout_objective"
        
        # Explore new areas
        self.current_target = self._explore_area()
        return self.current_target, "explore"
    
    def _explore_area(self) -> Vector2D:
        """Explore uncharted areas of the map"""
        # Find the point on the map farthest from known positions
        # Simple version: move toward a corner
        corners = [
            Vector2D(0, 0),
            Vector2D(self.game_state.arena_width, 0),

            Vector2D(self.game_state.arena_width, self.game_state.arena_height)
        ]
        
        # Find the corner farthest from current position
        farthest_corner = max(corners, key=lambda c: self.robot.position.distance_to(c))

class StrategyLearner:
    """Machine learning component for strategy adaptation"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.strategy_weights = {
            "attack": 0.3,
            "defend": 0.3,
            "support": 0.2,
            "scout": 0.2
        }
        self.success_history = deque(maxlen=20)  # Last 20 successful strategies
        self.last_update_time = 0.0
    
    def update(self, game_state: GameState, delta_time: float):
        """Update strategy weights based on battle outcomes"""
        if time.time() - self.last_update_time < 10.0:  # Update every 10 seconds
            return
            
        # Analyze recent battle outcomes
        if len(game_state.battle_history) > 0:
            recent_battles = game_state.battle_history[-10:]  # Last 10 battles
            success_rates = self._calculate_success_rates(recent_battles)
            
            # Adjust strategy weights based on success rates
            for role, success_rate in success_rates.items():
                if success_rate > 0.6:  # High success
                    self.strategy_weights[role] = min(1.0, self.strategy_weights[role] + 0.05)
                elif success_rate < 0.3:  # Low success
                    self.strategy_weights[role] = max(0.1, self.strategy_weights[role] - 0.05)
            
            # Normalize weights
            total_weight = sum(self.strategy_weights.values())
            if total_weight > 0:
                for role in self.strategy_weights:
                    self.strategy_weights[role] /= total_weight
        
        self.last_update_time = time.time()

    def suggest_role(self, robot: Robot, game_state: GameState) -> RobotRole:
        """Suggest best role for robot based on current strategy weights"""
        # Get available roles

        # Find current role distribution
        role_counts = {}
        for r in game_state.robots:

                role_counts[r.role.value] = role_counts.get(r.role.value, 0) + 1
        
        # Calculate weighted preference based on success rates and balance

        best_score = -1
        
        for role in available_roles:
            role_str = role.value

            # Penalize if too many robots have this role

            team_robots = len(game_state.get_team_robots(robot.team))
            balance_penalty = current_count / team_robots * 0.5
            
            score = weight - balance_penalty
            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_role = role
        
        return best_role if best_role else RobotRole.ATTACKER

def distance(p1: Tuple[float, float], p2: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:
    """Calculate Euclidean distance between two points."""
    return math.sqrt((p2[0] - p1[0])**2 + (p2[1] - p1[1])**2)

def angle_between(p1: Tuple[float, float], p2: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:
    """Calculate angle from p1 to p2 in radians."""
    return math.atan2(p2[1] - p1[1], p2[0] - p1[0])

def normalize_vector(v: Tuple[float, float]) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """Normalize a 2D vector."""
    mag = math.sqrt(v[0]**2 + v[1]**2)
    if mag == 0:
        return (0, 0)
    return (v[0] / mag, v[1] / mag)

def clamp(value: float, min_val: float, max_val: float) -> float:
    """Clamp value between min and max."""
    return max(min_val, min(max_val, value))

def lerp(start: float, end: float, t: float) -> float:
    """Linear interpolation between start and end."""
    return start + t * (end - start)

def random_position_in_area(center: Tuple[float, float], radius: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """Generate a random position within a circle."""
    angle = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
    r = random.uniform(0, radius)
    return (center[0] + r * math.cos(angle), center[1] + r * math.sin(angle))

@dataclass
class Particle:
    """Visual particle effect for explosions, trails, etc."""
    position: Tuple[float, float]
    velocity: Tuple[float, float]
    color: Tuple[int, int, int]
    life: float
    max_life: float
    size: float
    type: str  # "explosion", "trail", "spark", "smoke"

    def update(self, dt: float) -> bool:
        """Update particle position and life. Return True if still alive."""
        self.position = (
            self.position[0] + self.velocity[0] * dt,
            self.position[1] + self.velocity[1] * dt
        )
        self.life -= dt
        self.size = self.size * (self.life / self.max_life)
        return self.life > 0

@dataclass
class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the arena."""
    id: int
    team: str
    position: Tuple[float, float]
    velocity: Tuple[float, float] = (0, 0)
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    shield: float = 0.0
    max_shield: float = 50.0
    armor: float = 0.0
    weapon: WeaponType = WeaponType.LASER_RIFLE
    weapon_ammo: int = 50
    weapon_cooldown: float = 0.0
    speed: float = 150.0
    max_speed: float = 150.0
    rotation: float = 0.0
    ai_state: AIState = AIState.IDLE
    ai_targets: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)  # IDs of enemy robots to target
    ai_allies: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)   # IDs of allied robots
    powerups: Dict[PowerUpType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # powerup_type -> duration_remaining
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    last_seen_enemies: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    last_seen_powerups: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    behavior_history: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # For learning
    score: int = 0
    team_objective_progress: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # objective_id -> progress
    is_alive: bool = True
    is_selected: bool = False
    last_updated: float = 0.0
    vision: float = VISION_RANGE
    has_advanced_ai: bool = False
    
    def apply_powerup(self, powerup_type: PowerUpType, duration: float):
        """Apply a power-up effect to the robot."""
        if powerup_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.speed = self.max_speed * POWERUP_PROPS[powerup_type]["value"]
        elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
            self.shield = min(self.max_shield, self.shield + POWERUP_PROPS[powerup_type]["value"])
        elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK:
            self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + POWERUP_PROPS[powerup_type]["value"])
        elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.AMMO_PACK:
            self.weapon_ammo = min(WEAPON_PROPS[self.weapon]["ammo"], self.weapon_ammo + POWERUP_PROPS[powerup_type]["value"])
        elif powerup_type == PowerUpType.ADVANCED_AI:
            self.has_advanced_ai = True
            self.vision = VISION_RANGE * 1.5
            self.max_speed *= 1.2
            self.speed = self.max_speed
            
        self.powerups[powerup_type] = duration

    def update_powerups(self, dt: float):
        """Update active power-ups and remove expired ones."""
        expired = []
        for powerup_type, duration in self.powerups.items():
            self.powerups[powerup_type] = max(0, duration - dt)
            if self.powerups[powerup_type] <= 0:
                expired.append(powerup_type)
        
        for exp in expired:
            if exp == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
                self.speed = self.max_speed
            elif exp == PowerUpType.ADVANCED_AI:
                self.has_advanced_ai = False
                self.vision = VISION_RANGE
                self.max_speed /= 1.2
                self.speed = self.max_speed
            del self.powerups[exp]

    def can_attack(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can fire its weapon."""
        return self.weapon_ammo > 0 and self.weapon_cooldown <= 0

    def fire_weapon(self, target_pos: Tuple[float, float]) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Fire the robot's weapon and return projectile data if successful."""
        if not self.can_attack():
            return None
            
        weapon_props = WEAPON_PROPS[self.weapon]
        
        # Calculate direction to target
        direction = normalize_vector((
            target_pos[0] - self.position[0],
            target_pos[1] - self.position[1]
        ))
        
        # Apply weapon properties
        projectile_speed = 500  # pixels per second
        projectile = {
            "type": "projectile",
            "source": self.id,
            "team": self.team,
            "position": self.position,
            "velocity": (
                direction[0] * projectile_speed,
                direction[1] * projectile_speed
            ),
            "damage": weapon_props["damage"],
            "color": weapon_props["color"],
            "range": weapon_props["range"],
            "impact_radius": 15 if self.weapon == WeaponType.ROCKET_LAUNCHER else 5,
            "weapon_type": self.weapon,
            "lifespan": weapon_props["range"] / projectile_speed
        }
        
        # Apply cooldown and consume ammo
        self.weapon_cooldown = weapon_props["cooldown"]
        self.weapon_ammo -= 1
        if self.weapon_ammo <= 0:
            self.weapon_cooldown = weapon_props["reload_time"]  # Start reload
        
        # Create particle effect
        return projectile

    def take_damage(self, damage: float, source_team: str) -> float:
        """Apply damage to the robot, considering shields and armor."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return 0
            
        # Apply shield first
        actual_damage = damage
        if self.shield > 0:
            shield_absorbed = min(self.shield, actual_damage)
            self.shield -= shield_absorbed
            actual_damage -= shield_absorbed
            
        # Apply armor reduction
        if self.armor > 0:
            actual_damage *= (1 - self.armor / 100)
            
        # Apply remaining damage to health
        self.health -= actual_damage
        
        # Check if robot is dead
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_alive = False
            self.health = 0
            
        return actual_damage

    def move_towards(self, target_pos: Tuple[float, float], dt: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """Move robot towards target position with obstacle avoidance."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return self.position
            
        # Calculate direction to target
        direction = normalize_vector((
            target_pos[0] - self.position[0],
            target_pos[1] - self.position[1]
        ))
        
        # Apply speed with power-up modifiers
        move_speed = self.speed * dt
        
        # Apply movement
        new_position = (
            self.position[0] + direction[0] * move_speed,
            self.position[1] + direction[1] * move_speed
        )
        
        # Keep within bounds
        new_position = (
            clamp(new_position[0], 20, SCREEN_WIDTH - 20),
            clamp(new_position[1], 20, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 20)
        )
        
        self.position = new_position
        self.rotation = angle_between(self.position, target_pos)
        
        return new_position

    def attack_nearest_enemy(self, enemies: List['Robot']) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Find and attack nearest enemy."""
        if not enemies:
            return None
            
        closest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: distance(self.position, e.position))
        if distance(self.position, closest_enemy.position) <= COMBAT_RANGE:
            return self.fire_weapon(closest_enemy.position)
        return None

    def update(self, dt: float, game_state: 'GameState') -> None:
        """Update robot state."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
            
        self.last_updated = time.time()
        self.weapon_cooldown = max(0, self.weapon_cooldown - dt)
        
        # Update powerups
        self.update_powerups(dt)
        
        # If reloading
        if self.weapon_ammo <= 0 and self.weapon_cooldown > 0:
            if self.weapon_cooldown <= 0:
                self.weapon_ammo = WEAPON_PROPS[self.weapon]["ammo"]
        
        # AI decision making based on state
        self._ai_decision_making(game_state, dt)

    def _ai_decision_making(self, game_state: 'GameState', dt: float):
        """Internal AI decision making system with learning capabilities."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
            
        # Get current state
        enemies = [robot for robot in game_state.robots if robot.team != self.team and robot.is_alive]
        allies = [robot for robot in game_state.robots if robot.team == self.team and robot.is_alive]
        powerups = [pu for pu in game_state.powerups if pu["active"]]
        hazards = game_state.hazards
        
        # Update perception
        self.last_seen_enemies = [e.id for e in enemies if distance(self.position, e.position) <= self.vision]
        self.last_seen_powerups = [i for i, pu in enumerate(powerups) if distance(self.position, pu["position"]) <= self.vision]
        
        # Adaptive behavior based on performance
        self._adaptive_ai_strategy(game_state, enemies, allies, powerups, hazards)
        
        # Update behavior history
        if time.time() - self.last_action_time > 0.5:
            self.behavior_history.append(self.ai_state.value)
            if len(self.behavior_history) > 10:
                self.behavior_history.pop(0)
        
        # Execute current AI state
        self._execute_ai_state(game_state, enemies, allies, powerups, hazards)

    def _adaptive_ai_strategy(self, game_state: 'GameState', enemies: List['Robot'], allies: List['Robot'], powerups: List[Dict], hazards: List[Dict]):
        """Adaptive AI strategy that adjusts based on team performance."""
        # Calculate team performance metrics
        team_alive_count = sum(1 for r in allies)
        team_total_health = sum(r.health for r in allies)
        team_score = game_state.team_scores.get(self.team, 0)
        
        # Adjust AI aggressiveness based on performance
        if team_alive_count <= 1 and team_total_health < 100:
            # Team is struggling, become more defensive and seek powerups
            self.ai_state = AIState.SEEK_POWERUP
            return
            
        if team_score >= game_state.target_score * 0.8 and len(enemies) <= len(allies) * 0.7:
            # Team is winning, become more aggressive
            if len(enemies) > 0:
                self.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK
            return
            
        # If we have advanced AI, use more sophisticated behavior
        if self.has_advanced_ai:
            # Advanced AI can coordinate with team better
            if len(allies) > 2:
                # Try to flank or support
                self.ai_state = self._advanced_team_strategy(game_state, enemies, allies)
            return
            
        # Default behavior based on situation
        if len(enemies) == 0:
            self.ai_state = AIState.PATROL
        elif len(enemies) > len(allies) * 1.5:
            self.ai_state = AIState.RETREAT
        elif len(enemies) > 0 and distance(self.position, game_state.get_objective_position(self.team)) < 100:
            self.ai_state = AIState.DEFEND
        else:
            self.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK

    def _advanced_team_strategy(self, game_state: 'GameState', enemies: List['Robot'], allies: List['Robot']) -> AIState:
        """Advanced AI strategy for coordinated team play."""
        # Find role based on current situation
        if len(allies) >= 3:
            # Assign roles: attacker, defender, support
            my_health_ratio = self.health / self.max_health
            
            # Find objectives
            objective_pos = game_state.get_objective_position(self.team)
            dist_to_obj = distance(self.position, objective_pos)
            
            # Determine if we're the best candidate for a role
            closest_to_obj = min(allies, key=lambda r: distance(r.position, objective_pos))
            if self == closest_to_obj and dist_to_obj < 150:
                # We're closest to objective, defend
                return AIState.DEFEND
                
            # Check if there's an enemy near our objective
            nearby_enemies = [e for e in enemies if distance(e.position, objective_pos) < 200]
            if len(nearby_enemies) > 0:
                # We're near objective under attack, defend
                return AIState.DEFEND
                
            # Look for enemy near flag or payload
            if game_state.current_objective_type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_THE_FLAG:
                flag_pos = game_state.get_objective_position("RED") if self.team == "BLUE" else game_state.get_objective_position("BLUE")
                dist_to_flag = distance(self.position, flag_pos)
                if dist_to_flag < 300:
                    # We're close to enemy flag, capture
                    return AIState.CAPTURE
                    
        return AIState.ATTACK

    def _execute_ai_state(self, game_state: 'GameState', enemies: List['Robot'], allies: List['Robot'], powerups: List[Dict], hazards: List[Dict]):
        """Execute current AI state behavior."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
            
        # Update weapon if needed
        if self.weapon_ammo <= 0:
            # Try to find ammo powerup
            ammo_powerup = next((pu for pu in powerups if pu["type"] == PowerUpType.AMMO_PACK), None)
            if ammo_powerup and distance(self.position, ammo_powerup["position"]) < 100:
                self.ai_state = AIState.SEEK_POWERUP

def distance(p1: Tuple[float, float], p2: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:
    """Calculate Euclidean distance between two points."""
    return math.sqrt((p2[0] - p1[0])**2 + (p2[1] - p1[1])**2)

def angle_between(p1: Tuple[float, float], p2: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:
    """Calculate angle from p1 to p2 in radians."""
    return math.atan2(p2[1] - p1[1], p2[0] - p1[0])

def normalize_vector(v: Tuple[float, float]) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """Normalize a 2D vector."""
    mag = math.sqrt(v[0]**2 + v[1]**2)
    if mag == 0:
        return (0, 0)
    return (v[0] / mag, v[1] / mag)

def clamp(value: float, min_val: float, max_val: float) -> float:
    """Clamp value between min and max."""
    return max(min_val, min(max_val, value))

def lerp(start: float, end: float, t: float) -> float:
    """Linear interpolation between start and end."""
    return start + t * (end - start)

def random_position_in_area(center: Tuple[float, float], radius: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """Generate a random position within a circle."""
    angle = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
    r = random.uniform(0, radius)
    return (center[0] + r * math.cos(angle), center[1] + r * math.sin(angle))

    position: Tuple[float, float]

    life: float
    max_life: float
    size: float
    type: str  # "explosion", "trail", "spark", "smoke"

    def update(self, dt: float) -> bool:
        """Update particle position and life. Return True if still alive."""
        self.position = (
            self.position[0] + self.velocity[0] * dt,
            self.position[1] + self.velocity[1] * dt
        )
        self.life -= dt
        self.size = self.size * (self.life / self.max_life)
        return self.life > 0

    def take_damage(self, damage: float, source_team: str) -> float:
        """Apply damage to the robot, considering shields and armor."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return 0
            
        # Apply shield first
        actual_damage = damage
        if self.shield > 0:
            shield_absorbed = min(self.shield, actual_damage)
            self.shield -= shield_absorbed
            actual_damage -= shield_absorbed
            
        # Apply armor reduction
        if self.armor > 0:
            actual_damage *= (1 - self.armor / 100)
            
        # Apply remaining damage to health
        self.health -= actual_damage
        
        # Check if robot is dead
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.is_alive = False
            self.health = 0
            
        return actual_damage

    def move_towards(self, target_pos: Tuple[float, float], dt: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """Move robot towards target position with obstacle avoidance."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return self.position
            
        # Calculate direction to target
        direction = normalize_vector((
            target_pos[0] - self.position[0],
            target_pos[1] - self.position[1]
        ))
        
        # Apply speed with power-up modifiers
        move_speed = self.speed * dt
        
        # Apply movement
        new_position = (
            self.position[0] + direction[0] * move_speed,
            self.position[1] + direction[1] * move_speed
        )
        
        # Keep within bounds
        new_position = (
            clamp(new_position[0], 20, SCREEN_WIDTH - 20),
            clamp(new_position[1], 20, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 20)
        )
        
        self.position = new_position
        self.rotation = angle_between(self.position, target_pos)
        
        return new_position

    def attack_nearest_enemy(self, enemies: List['Robot']) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Find and attack nearest enemy."""
        if not enemies:
            return None
            
        closest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: distance(self.position, e.position))
        if distance(self.position, closest_enemy.position) <= COMBAT_RANGE:
            return self.fire_weapon(closest_enemy.position)
        return None

    def update(self, dt: float, game_state: 'GameState') -> None:
        """Update robot state."""
        if not self.is_alive:

        self.last_updated = time.time()
        self.weapon_cooldown = max(0, self.weapon_cooldown - dt)
        
        # Update powerups
        self.update_powerups(dt)
        
        # If reloading
        if self.weapon_ammo <= 0 and self.weapon_cooldown > 0:
            if self.weapon_cooldown <= 0:
                self.weapon_ammo = WEAPON_PROPS[self.weapon]["ammo"]
        
        # AI decision making based on state
        self._ai_decision_making(game_state, dt)

    def _ai_decision_making(self, game_state: 'GameState', dt: float):
        """Internal AI decision making system with learning capabilities."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
            
        # Get current state
        enemies = [robot for robot in game_state.robots if robot.team != self.team and robot.is_alive]
        allies = [robot for robot in game_state.robots if robot.team == self.team and robot.is_alive]
        powerups = [pu for pu in game_state.powerups if pu["active"]]
        hazards = game_state.hazards
        
        # Update perception
        self.last_seen_enemies = [e.id for e in enemies if distance(self.position, e.position) <= self.vision]
        self.last_seen_powerups = [i for i, pu in enumerate(powerups) if distance(self.position, pu["position"]) <= self.vision]
        
        # Adaptive behavior based on performance
        self._adaptive_ai_strategy(game_state, enemies, allies, powerups, hazards)
        
        # Update behavior history
        if time.time() - self.last_action_time > 0.5:
            self.behavior_history.append(self.ai_state.value)
            if len(self.behavior_history) > 10:
                self.behavior_history.pop(0)
        
        # Execute current AI state
        self._execute_ai_state(game_state, enemies, allies, powerups, hazards)

    def _adaptive_ai_strategy(self, game_state: 'GameState', enemies: List['Robot'], allies: List['Robot'], powerups: List[Dict], hazards: List[Dict]):
        """Adaptive AI strategy that adjusts based on team performance."""
        # Calculate team performance metrics
        team_alive_count = sum(1 for r in allies)
        team_total_health = sum(r.health for r in allies)
        team_score = game_state.team_scores.get(self.team, 0)
        
        # Adjust AI aggressiveness based on performance
        if team_alive_count <= 1 and team_total_health < 100:
            # Team is struggling, become more defensive and seek powerups
            self.ai_state = AIState.SEEK_POWERUP
            return
            
        if team_score >= game_state.target_score * 0.8 and len(enemies) <= len(allies) * 0.7:
            # Team is winning, become more aggressive
            if len(enemies) > 0:
                self.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK
            return
            
        # If we have advanced AI, use more sophisticated behavior
        if self.has_advanced_ai:
            # Advanced AI can coordinate with team better
            if len(allies) > 2:
                # Try to flank or support
                self.ai_state = self._advanced_team_strategy(game_state, enemies, allies)
            return
            
        # Default behavior based on situation
        if len(enemies) == 0:
            self.ai_state = AIState.PATROL
        elif len(enemies) > len(allies) * 1.5:
            self.ai_state = AIState.RETREAT
        elif len(enemies) > 0 and distance(self.position, game_state.get_objective_position(self.team)) < 100:
            self.ai_state = AIState.DEFEND
        else:
            self.ai_state = AIState.ATTACK

    def _advanced_team_strategy(self, game_state: 'GameState', enemies: List['Robot'], allies: List['Robot']) -> AIState:

            # Determine if we're the best candidate for a role
            closest_to_obj = min(allies, key=lambda r: distance(r.position, objective_pos))
            if self == closest_to_obj and dist_to_obj < 150:

                return AIState.DEFEND
                
            # Check if there's an enemy near our objective
            nearby_enemies = [e for e in enemies if distance(e.position, objective_pos) < 200]
            if len(nearby_enemies) > 0:

                return AIState.DEFEND

                flag_pos = game_state.get_objective_position("RED") if self.team == "BLUE" else game_state.get_objective_position("BLUE")
                dist_to_flag = distance(self.position, flag_pos)
                if dist_to_flag < 300:
                    # We're close to enemy flag, capture
                    return AIState.CAPTURE

    def _execute_ai_state(self, game_state: 'GameState', enemies: List['Robot'], allies: List['Robot'], powerups: List[Dict], hazards: List[Dict]):
        """Execute current AI state behavior."""
        if not self.is_alive:
            return
            
        # Update weapon if needed
        if self.weapon_ammo <= 0:
            # Try to find ammo powerup
            ammo_powerup = next((pu for pu in powerups if pu["type"] == PowerUpType.AMMO_PACK), None)
            if ammo_powerup and distance(self.position, ammo_powerup["position"]) < 100:
                self.ai_state = AIState.SEEK_POWERUP
                return

            # Idle state: move to a random spot
            target = random_position_in_area(self.position, 100)
            self.move_towards(target, 1/FPS)
            
        elif self.ai_state == AIState.PATROL:
            # Patrol between 2-3 random patrol points
            if not hasattr(self, 'patrol_points'):
                self.patrol_points = [random_position_in_area(self.position, 200) for _ in range(3)]
            if not hasattr(self, 'current_patrol_index'):

            target = self.patrol_points[self.current_patrol_index]
            if distance(self.position, target) < 30:

def distance(p1: Tuple[float, float], p2: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:
    """Calculate Euclidean distance between two points."""
    return math.sqrt((p2[0] - p1[0])**2 + (p2[1] - p1[1])**2)

def angle_between(p1: Tuple[float, float], p2: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:
    """Calculate angle from p1 to p2 in radians."""
    return math.atan2(p2[1] - p1[1], p2[0] - p1[0])

def normalize_vector(v: Tuple[float, float]) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """Normalize a 2D vector."""
    mag = math.sqrt(v[0]**2 + v[1]**2)
    if mag == 0:
        return (0, 0)
    return (v[0] / mag, v[1] / mag)

def clamp(value: float, min_val: float, max_val: float) -> float:
    """Clamp value between min and max."""
    return max(min_val, min(max_val, value))

def lerp(start: float, end: float, t: float) -> float:
    """Linear interpolation between start and end."""
    return start + t * (end - start)

def random_position_in_area(center: Tuple[float, float], radius: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    """Generate a random position within a circle."""
    angle = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
    r = random.uniform(0, radius)
    return (center[0] + r * math.cos(angle), center[1] + r * math.sin(angle))

        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:

        return Vector2D(self.x / mag, self.y / mag)
    
    def distance_to(self, other):

    def copy(self):

    max_health: float = 100.0
    shield: float = 0.0
    shield_regen_rate: float = 0.2
    shield_max: float = 50.0
    role: RobotRole = RobotRole.ATTACKER
    weapon: 'Weapon' = None
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    cooldowns: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    strategy_history: List[Dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    ai_memory: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    is_alive: bool = True
    is_capturing: bool = False
    capture_progress: float = 0.0
    power_ups: Dict[PowerUpType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    def apply_damage(self, amount: float, damage_type: str = "normal") -> float:
        """Apply damage to robot, accounting for shields"""
        damage_taken = amount
        if self.shield > 0:
            shield_absorbed = min(self.shield, damage_taken)
            self.shield -= shield_absorbed
            damage_taken -= shield_absorbed
        
        if damage_taken > 0:
            self.health -= damage_taken
            if self.health <= 0:
                self.is_alive = False
                self.health = 0
                
        return damage_taken
    
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot, respecting max health"""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
    
    def recharge_shield(self):
        """Recharge shield over time"""
        if self.shield < self.shield_max:
            self.shield = min(self.shield_max, self.shield + self.shield_regen_rate)
    
    def add_power_up(self, power_type: PowerUpType, duration: float):
        """Add a power-up with duration"""
        self.power_ups[power_type] = duration
    
    def update_power_ups(self, dt: float):
        """Update power-up durations and remove expired ones"""
        to_remove = []
        for power_type, duration in self.power_ups.items():
            self.power_ups[power_type] = duration - dt
            if self.power_ups[power_type] <= 0:
                to_remove.append(power_type)
        
        for power_type in to_remove:
            del self.power_ups[power_type]
    
    def get_active_power_ups(self) -> List[PowerUpType]:
        """Return list of active power-ups"""
        return [p for p, dur in self.power_ups.items() if dur > 0]
    
    def can_act(self, cooldown_name: str, cooldown_time: float) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can perform an action based on cooldown"""
        if cooldown_name not in self.cooldowns:
            self.cooldowns[cooldown_name] = 0
        return time.time() - self.cooldowns[cooldown_name] >= cooldown_time
    
    def set_cooldown(self, cooldown_name: str, duration: float):
        """Set a cooldown on an action"""
        self.cooldowns[cooldown_name] = time.time()

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    name: str
    weapon_type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    fire_rate: float  # seconds between shots
    ammo: int
    max_ammo: int
    reload_time: float
    is_active: bool = True
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        self.current_ammo = self.ammo
        self.last_fired = 0.0
        self.is_reloading = False
    
    def can_fire(self) -> bool:
        """Check if weapon can fire"""
        current_time = time.time()
        if self.is_reloading:
            return False
        if self.current_ammo <= 0:
            return False
        if current_time - self.last_fired < self.fire_rate:
            return False
        return True
    
    def fire(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Fire the weapon, return projectile type or None"""
        if not self.can_fire():
            return None
        
        self.current_ammo -= 1
        self.last_fired = time.time()
        
        if self.current_ammo <= 0:
            self.is_reloading = True
            # Start reload timer
            threading.Timer(self.reload_time, self._reload_complete).start()
        
        return self.weapon_type.name
    
    def _reload_complete(self):
        """Complete reload process"""
        self.current_ammo = self.max_ammo
        self.is_reloading = False

class AIBehaviorTree:
    """Behavior tree for robot AI with adaptive learning"""
    
    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, game_state: GameState):
        self.robot = robot
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.current_node = None
        self.memory = robot.ai_memory
        self.decision_history = deque(maxlen=20)  # Keep last 20 decisions
        self.learning_rate = 0.1  # How quickly AI adapts
        
    def evaluate(self, dt: float) -> str:
        """Evaluate behavior tree and return next action"""
        if not self.robot.is_alive:
            return "dead"
        
        # Update AI memory with current state
        self._update_memory()
        
        # Adaptive difficulty: adjust behavior based on team performance
        difficulty_factor = self._get_difficulty_factor()
        
        # Behavior tree structure (top-down priority)
        actions = [
            self._check_dead,
            self._check_objective_nearby,
            self._check_enemies_nearby,
            self._check_power_up_nearby,
            self._check_hazards_nearby,
            self._move_toward_objective,
            self._patrol,
            self._random_move
        ]
        
        for action in actions:
            result = action(difficulty_factor, dt)
            if result:
                return result
        
        return "idle"
    
    def _update_memory(self):
        """Update AI memory with current state"""
        # Track recent actions
        recent_actions = [act for act in self.robot.strategy_history[-5:] if act.get('action')]
        if recent_actions:
            self.memory['recent_actions'] = recent_actions
        
        # Track enemies that have damaged robot
        if 'last_damage_source' in self.memory and self.memory['last_damage_source']:
            self.memory['enemy_threat_level'] = self.memory.get('enemy_threat_level', 0) + 1
        
        # Track teammates' positions
        teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == self.robot.team and r.is_alive]
        if len(teammates) > 1:
            self.memory['teammate_positions'] = [(t.position.x, t.position.y) for t in teammates]
    
    def _get_difficulty_factor(self) -> float:
        """Calculate difficulty factor based on team performance"""
        team_scores = self.game_state.stats.team_scores
        team_kills = self.game_state.stats.kills
        total_kills = sum(team_kills.values())
        
        if total_kills == 0:
            return 1.0
        
        # If team is winning, make AI more aggressive
        team_score = team_scores.get(self.robot.team, 0)
        opponent_score = team_scores.get(1 - self.robot.team, 0)
        
        if team_score > opponent_score:
            # Team is winning, make AI more conservative
            return max(0.5, 1.0 - (team_score - opponent_score) / 50)
        else:
            # Team is losing, make AI more aggressive
            return min(1.5, 1.0 + (opponent_score - team_score) / 50)
    
    def _check_dead(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        if not self.robot.is_alive:
            return "dead"
        return None
    
    def _check_objective_nearby(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Check if objective is nearby and needs attention"""
        if not self.game_state.objectives:
            return None
            
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            if not obj.is_active or obj.team_owned == self.robot.team:
                continue
                
            distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
            if distance < 150 * difficulty_factor:
                # If robot is already capturing, continue
                if self.robot.is_capturing and self.robot.capture_progress < 1.0:
                    return "continue_capturing"
                
                # If objective is unowned and we're in the right role
                if obj.team_required is None or obj.team_required == self.robot.team:
                    return "capture_objective"
        
        return None
    
    def _check_enemies_nearby(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Check for nearby enemies and decide attack strategy"""
        enemies = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team != self.robot.team and r.is_alive]
        
        if not enemies:
            return None
            
        nearest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.position.distance_to(e.position))
        distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(nearest_enemy.position)
        
        # If enemy is very close, go for melee
        if distance < 60:
            return "melee_attack"
        
        # If enemy is within weapon range, use ranged attack
        if self.robot.weapon and distance < self.robot.weapon.range * 1.2:
            # Check if we can fire
            if self.robot.weapon.can_fire():
                return "ranged_attack"
            else:
                return "reposition_for_shot"
        
        # If enemy is close but out of range, move toward
        if distance < 200:
            return "approach_enemy"
        
        return None
    
    def _check_power_up_nearby(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Check for nearby power-ups"""
        if not self.game_state.power_ups:
            return None
            
        for power_up in self.game_state.power_ups:
            if not power_up.active:
                continue
                
            distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(power_up.position)
            if distance < 100 * difficulty_factor:
                # Prioritize certain power-ups based on robot role
                if power_up.type == PowerUpType.BOOST and self.robot.role == RobotRole.SCAT:
                    return "grab_boost"
                elif power_up.type == PowerUpType.SHIELD and self.robot.health < 50:
                    return "grab_shield"
                elif power_up.type == PowerUpType.REGEN and self.robot.health < 70:
                    return "grab_regen"
                elif power_up.type == PowerUpType.OVERDRIVE:
                    return "grab_overdrive"
                else:
                    return "grab_powerup"
        
        return None
    
    def _check_hazards_nearby(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Check for nearby hazards and avoid them"""
        if not self.game_state.hazards:
            return None
            
        for hazard in self.game_state.hazards:
            if not hazard.active:
                continue
                
            distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position)
            if distance < hazard.radius + 50:
                # Avoid hazard if it's dangerous
                if hazard.type == HazardType.LAVA or hazard.type == HazardType.ELECTRIC:
                    # Move away from hazard
                    direction = (self.robot.position - hazard.position).normalize()
                    # Add random component to avoid predictable movement
                    angle = random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5)
                    direction = Vector2D(
                        direction.x * math.cos(angle) - direction.y * math.sin(angle),
                        direction.x * math.sin(angle) + direction.y * math.cos(angle)
                    )
                    self.robot.velocity = direction * MAX_SPEED * 0.7
                    return "avoid_hazard"
        
        return None
    
    def _move_toward_objective(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Move toward the nearest objective"""
        if not self.game_state.objectives:
            return None
            
        # Find objectives this team needs to capture or defend
        target_objectives = []
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            if not obj.is_active:
                continue
            # Capture objectives that are unowned or owned by enemy
            if obj.team_owned != self.robot.team:
                target_objectives.append(obj)
            # Defend objectives that are owned by our team
            elif obj.team_owned == self.robot.team and self.robot.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:
                target_objectives.append(obj)
        
        if not target_objectives:
            return None
            
        # Choose closest objective
        nearest_obj = min(target_objectives, key=lambda o: self.robot.position.distance_to(o.position))
        direction = (nearest_obj.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
        self.robot.velocity = direction * MAX_SPEED * difficulty_factor
        
        return "move_to_objective"
    
    def _patrol(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Patrol a designated area"""
        # Use memory of patrol points
        patrol_points = self.memory.get('patrol_points', [])
        
        if not patrol_points:
            # Generate random patrol points
            center = self.robot.position
            patrol_points = [
                center + Vector2D(100, 100),
                center + Vector2D(100, -100),
                center + Vector2D(-100, -100),
                center + Vector2D(-100, 100)
            ]
            self.memory['patrol_points'] = patrol_points
        
        if 'current_patrol_target' not in self.memory:
            self.memory['current_patrol_target'] = 0
        
        target = patrol_points[self.memory['current_patrol_target']]
        distance = self.robot.position.distance_to(target)
        
        if distance < 20:
            # Move to next point
            self.memory['current_patrol_target'] = (self.memory['current_patrol_target'] + 1) % len(patrol_points)
            target = patrol_points[self.memory['current_patrol_target']]
        
        direction = (target - self.robot.position).normalize()
        self.robot.velocity = direction * MAX_SPEED * 0.5
        
        return "patrol"
    
    def _random_move(self, difficulty_factor: float, dt: float) -> str:
        """Random movement when no better option"""
        # Add slight randomness to avoid static patterns
        angle = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)
        direction = Vector2D(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle))
        self.robot.velocity = direction * MAX_SPEED * 0.3
        return "random_move"

# TEAM STRATEGY SYSTEM
# ============================

class TeamStrategyManager:
    """Manages team-level strategies and coordination"""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.team_strategies = {}
        self.strategy_cooldowns = {}
        self.last_strategy_update = 0
        self.strategy_history = deque(maxlen=10)
        
    def update(self, dt: float) -> None:
        """Update team strategies based on game state"""
        current_time = time.time()
        if current_time - self.last_strategy_update < 2.0:  # Update every 2 seconds
            return
            
        self.last_strategy_update = current_time
        
        # Analyze team performance and adjust strategies
        for team_id in range(TEAM_COUNT):
            team_robots = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == team_id and r.is_alive]
            enemy_robots = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team != team_id and r.is_alive]
            
            if not team_robots:
                continue
                
            # Calculate team performance metrics
            team_health = sum(r.health for r in team_robots) / len(team_robots)
            team_kills = self.game_state.stats.kills.get(team_id, 0)
            enemy_kills = self.game_state.stats.kills.get(1 - team_id, 0)
            
            # Determine optimal strategy
            strategy = self._determine_optimal_strategy(team_robots, enemy_robots, team_health, team_kills, enemy_kills)
            
            # Apply strategy to team
            self._apply_strategy(team_id, strategy, team_robots)
            
            # Record strategy for learning
            self.strategy_history.append({
                'team': team_id,
                'strategy': strategy,
                'timestamp': current_time,
                'health': team_health,
                'kills': team_kills,
                'enemy_kills': enemy_kills
            })
    
    def _determine_optimal_strategy(self, team_robots: List[Robot], enemy_robots: List[Robot], 
                                  team_health: float, team_kills: int, enemy_kills: int) -> str:
        """Determine best team strategy based on current state"""
        objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if obj.is_active and obj.team_required is None]
        
        # If we have a clear advantage, go aggressive
        if team_kills > enemy_kills + 3:
            return "offensive_push"
        
        # If we're losing, go defensive
        if enemy_kills > team_kills + 3:
            return "defensive_hold"
        
        # If health is low, go defensive
        if team_health < 40:
            return "defensive_hold"
        
        # If we have many robots alive and objectives are close, push
        if len(team_robots) >= 3 and len(objectives) > 0:
            # Check if any objective is close to capture
            for obj in objectives:
                distance = min(r.position.distance_to(obj.position) for r in team_robots)
                if distance < 100:
                    return "capture_objective"
        
        # Default strategy based on game mode
        if self.game_state.game_mode == GameMode.FLAG_CAPTURE:
            return "flag_control"
        elif self.game_state.game_mode == GameMode.ESCORTE_PAYLOAD:
            return "escort_payload"
        else:
            return "balanced"
    
    def _apply_strategy(self, team_id: int, strategy: str, team_robots: List[Robot]) -> None:
        """Apply strategy to robots by adjusting their roles"""
        if not team_robots:
            return
            
        # Assign roles based on strategy
        if strategy == "offensive_push":
            # Assign 3 attackers, 1 defender
            roles = [RobotRole.ATTACKER] * 3 + [RobotRole.DEFENDER]
        elif strategy == "defensive_hold":
            # Assign 2 defenders, 1 support, 1 attacker
            roles = [RobotRole.DEFENDER] * 2 + [RobotRole.SUPPORT] + [RobotRole.ATTACKER]
        elif strategy == "capture_objective":
            # Assign 2 attackers, 2 defenders
            roles = [RobotRole.ATTACKER] * 2 + [RobotRole.DEFENDER] * 2
        elif strategy == "flag_control":
            # For flag capture, assign 2 attackers, 1 defender, 1 scout
            roles = [RobotRole.ATTACKER] * 2 + [RobotRole.DEFENDER] + [RobotRole.SCAT]
        elif strategy == "escort_payload":
            # For escort, assign 2 defenders, 1 escort, 1 scout
            roles = [RobotRole.DEFENDER] * 2 + [RobotRole.SUPPORT] + [RobotRole.SCAT]
        else:  # balanced
            # Even distribution
            roles = [RobotRole.ATTACKER, RobotRole.DEFENDER, RobotRole.SUPPORT, RobotRole.SCAT]
        
        # Assign roles to robots
        for i, robot in enumerate(team_robots):
            if i < len(roles):
                robot.role = roles[i]
        
        # Store strategy in memory for learning
        for robot in team_robots:
            robot.ai_memory['current_strategy'] = strategy

# DYNAMICS AND PHYSICS ENGINE
